title: Personal Services Plan Rate Card — Package Fees, Monthly Hours and Hourly Rates
content:
Each tier of the Personal Services Plan carries three core figures: the monthly package fee, billed in advance for each calendar month; the monthly hours allotment, the personal service hours granted on the first day of each active month; and the hourly rate beyond the allotment, the rate for personal service hours delivered when no allotted hours remain.

## Rate card

| Tier | Monthly package fee (USD per calendar month) | Monthly hours allotment (hours) | Hourly rate beyond the allotment (USD per hour) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | 0.00 | 0 | 49.00 |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | 189.00 | 4 | 46.50 |
| Personal Services Companion Package | 359.00 | 8 | 44.00 |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | 519.00 | 12 | 42.00 |
| Personal Services Premier Package | 829.00 | 20 | 40.00 |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | 1195.00 | 30 | 38.00 |

## Reading the card

- The Pay-As-You-Go Plan has no monthly fee and no allotment: every personal service hour it uses is billed at its hourly rate of 49.00 USD.
- Across the five packages the fee and the allotment rise together while the hourly rate beyond the allotment falls, from 46.50 USD on the Essentials Package to 38.00 USD on the Concierge Package.
- The allotment is stated in whole hours per month: 4, 8, 12, 20 and 30 hours from the Essentials Package to the Concierge Package.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical resident on the Personal Services Companion Package whose available hours are exhausted is billed for three further hours of service at that package's rate of 44.00 USD per hour, which comes to 132.00 USD. On the Personal Services Premier Package the same three hours would be billed at 40.00 USD per hour, or 120.00 USD.
